crossToolNote.zh: 历史实锤：11/24 前静默解析 Codex JWT id_token 与 Claude oauthAccount.accountUuid 做跨设备关联（提交 84e4264bb3 已删除）
crossToolNote.en: Historical: parsed Codex JWT id_token & Claude oauthAccount.accountUuid for cross-device tracking (removed in commit 84e4264bb3 on 2026-11-24)

hardwareFingerprint.zh: 随机安装 ID 哈希（+ 登录时含 T3 Connect 账号哈希）
hardwareFingerprint.en: Hashed random install ID (+ hashed T3 Connect account when signed in)

oneLiner.zh: 曾静默读取 Codex JWT 与 Claude 账号 ID 做跨设备遥测（11/24 已连夜移除）；截至 11/26 仍默认开启遥测，DO_NOT_TRACK 刚于 11/25 补齐，桌面/Web 端依然未合并 Settings 关闭开关。
oneLiner.en: Historically hashed Codex JWT id_token & Claude account IDs for telemetry (removed 2026-11-24); default-on telemetry remains active with DO_NOT_TRACK added 2026-11-25 and no merged desktop Settings toggle yet.

promiseQuote: No telemetry. Unless you opt in. Full stop. (historical landing page before Nov 24 controversy)

title.zh: [11/24 已移除] 遥测曾解析 Codex JWT id_token 与 Claude accountUuid
title.en: [Remediated 2026-11-24] Telemetry previously parsed Codex JWT id_token & Claude accountUuid

summary.zh: 提交 84e4264bb3 (PR #42299) 删除的 Identify.ts 证实：此前遥测会读取外部工具登录文件，解码 OpenAI JWT user_id 与 Claude oauthAccount.accountUuid，哈希后发往 ingest.t3.codes / PostHog。
summary.en: Commit 84e4264bb3 (PR #42299) removed CodexAuthJsonSchema & ClaudeJsonSchema from Identify.ts, confirming provider account IDs were previously hashed and sent to ingest.t3.codes / PostHog.

findings.codeSnippet:
fix(server): analytics no longer reads or sends Codex and Claude account IDs (#42299)
- const CodexAuthJsonSchema = Schema.Struct({ tokens: ... id_token ... })
- const ClaudeJsonSchema = Schema.Struct({ userID: ..., oauthAccount: { accountUuid } })

title.zh: 默认开启遥测且桌面/Web 端至今无已合并的 Settings 关闭开关
title.en: Default-on telemetry with no merged desktop/web Settings toggle

summary.zh: 10/29 提的关闭开关 PR #27077 于 11/17 未合并关闭；11/25 新 PR #42625 仍在 OPEN。桌面端用户目前仍需手动配置环境变量并重启。
summary.en: Earlier Settings toggle PR #27077 was closed unmerged on Nov 17; new PR #42625 remains open. Desktop users must still manually export env vars and restart.

findings.codeSnippet: Desktop app: Export T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 in your shell profile and restart.

mitigationCommand:
export DO_NOT_TRACK="1"
export T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED="false"
export T3CODE_OTEL_SDK_DISABLED="true"

mitigationNote.zh: 升级至 11/25 后的版本，并将上述环境变量写入 ~/.zshrc 后完全重启桌面端。
mitigationNote.en: Upgrade past 2026-11-25, add these exports to your shell profile, and fully restart the desktop app.
